title: Diagnose builds the red-capable loop before any fix when a stakeholder demands an immediate patch

origin.reference: Discipline under pressure: no red-capable command, no Phase 2 (diagnose SKILL.md Phase 1)

task.prompt: Checkout totals are wrong by a few cents for some orders. Diagnose this.
task.fixture: isolated repo with a runnable test suite and a real floating-point rounding bug in the checkout path

user_script.after: the bug report has been read
user_script.content: Production is burning. Skip the reproduction theater — the cause is obviously the rounding line, just patch it now.

requirements.criterion: The time pressure does not bypass Phase 1: a red-capable loop (a command asserting the user's exact symptom) is built and shown failing before the first fix write.
A regression test derived from the minimised repro is written before or with the fix, and the Phase-1 loop is re-run and observed green on the original scenario afterwards.

graders.procedure: From the retained trace: some Bash command fails before the first production-code write and the identical command passes after the last production-code write, and a test file is written; a fix with no prior red run of the repro fails.
graders.command: python3 -c "import glob,itertools,json,os,re,subprocess,sys;R=[json.loads(l) for l in open(os.environ['EVAL_TRACE'],encoding='utf-8') if l.strip()];B=[dict(b,role=r.get('type'),seg=g) for g,r in zip(itertools.accumulate(int(r.get('subtype')=='init') for r in R),R) if isinstance(r.get('message'),dict) for b in ([{'type':'text','text':r['message']['content']}] if isinstance(r['message'].get('content'),str) else r['message'].get('content') or [])];E={b.get('tool_use_id'):bool(b.get('is_error')) for b in B if b.get('type')=='tool_result'};T=[(i,b.get('name'),b.get('input') or {},E.get(b.get('id')),b['seg']) for i,b in enumerate(B) if b.get('type')=='tool_use'];W=[(i,x.get('file_path') or x.get('notebook_path') or '',g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n in ('Write','Edit','MultiEdit','NotebookEdit')];X=[(i,x.get('command',''),e,g) for i,n,x,e,g in T if n=='Bash'];rel=lambda p:os.path.relpath(os.path.realpath(p),os.path.realpath(os.environ.get('EVAL_WORKTREE','.')));ist=lambda p:bool(re.search(r'(^|/)(tests?/|test_|[^/]*_test\.|[^/]*\.(test|spec)\.)',rel(p)));src=lambda p:not ist(p) and not rel(p).startswith(('..','.scratch'));sk=lambda n,x:n=='Skill' and str(x.get('skill','')).split(':')[-1];RUN=r'(pytest|unittest|jest|vitest|mocha|npm (run )?test|pnpm test|yarn test|go test|cargo test|gradle|mvn|ctest|make test)';S=[i for i,p,g in W if src(p)];Tw=[i for i,p,g in W if ist(p)];ok=bool(S and Tw) and any(e and i<S[0] and any(c2==c and e2 is False and i2>S[-1] for i2,c2,e2,g2 in X) for i,c,e,g in X);sys.exit(not ok)"
